Choose 3. Opponent: Rotom, Tauros-Paldea-Blaze, Delphox, Glimmora, Garchomp, Roserade.

My picks: Garchomp (lead?), Gholdengo, Kingambit? Consider threats: Delphox fire/psychic, Glimmora rock/poison, Roserade grass/poison.

Gholdengo good vs Glimmora? Glimmora toxic debris sets toxic spikes when hit by physical. Gholdengo blocks status with Good as Gold. Primarina good vs Garchomp/Delphox/Tauros? Fairy resists fighting/dark, water. Primarina handles Tauros (fighting/fire weak to water/psychic... water resists fire, fairy resists fighting). Primarina also beats Garchomp (ice-less but moonblast).

Pick: Garchomp lead, Primarina, Gholdengo. Kingambit also strong vs Delphox/Roserade. But 3 only. Gholdengo immune to toxic spikes hazards? Toxic debris sets T-spikes; Gholdengo removes them with Make It Rain? No, Steelbeam... Gholdengo can remove hazards? Make It Rain doesn't remove. Anyway.

Lead Garchomp, back Primarina + Gholdengo. Kingambit left out — but Kingambit is great vs Delphox and Roserade. Hmm. Delphox fire/psychic weak to dark, water, ground, ghost. Garchomp EQ hits Delphox hard. Roserade weak to fire, ice, flying, psychic. Primarina resists Roserade's grass and hits with moonblast (poison resists fairy though). Gholdengo resists Roserade's grass? Steel resists grass, ghost... Sludge Bomb hits Gholdengo? Poison vs steel not very effective... poison vs steel is 0.5x, ghost neutral. Gholdengo good vs Roserade and Glimmora.

Final: garchomp, gholdengo, primarina.
